blocks.text: Ethereal is an aesthetic based around the feeling of being extremely delicate and light in a way that seems to be not of this world.

It is typically used in reference to Disney or Barbie princess movies and other fantasy films that are completely without irony in their dreamy romanticism. The imagery used is very wholesome, light, and soft, embracing the happiest parts of fairy tales.

It is a generalization of imagery that includes depictions of royalty (often princes and princesses), classical dancers, sweeping ballrooms, colorful gardens, pixie dust, fairies, angels, and the beauty of true love.
The visual style of this aesthetic is usually bright, dreamy and serene. Photography tends to have a soft focus effect or blurry quality to evoke a heavenly aura.
Nature is one of the primary visuals of the aesthetic, as many images include landscapes like ponds, forests, waterfalls, meadows, etc.

Ethereal fashion usually consists of feminine clothing in light pastel colors. Common attire includes long flowing dresses with lace, diamond jewelry, clear accessories, angel patterns, white fur, drop earrings, pleated skirts, white mesh, etc.
